Both source market/treatment references are-1kg; callers map at factor-1 to positive one-kg helpers and the negative treatment coefficient independently becomes positive complete native treatment. Reuse the standing same-waste/unit ordinary-MSWI whole-function screening correspondence and documented-composition rule: all42 wet-composition coordinates, including unknowns, match each specific native0%-water metal incinerator. Native documentation also matches source recovery308.48gAl or310gCu perkg; source recovered-stock links point only to positive production-only RecycledContentcutoff handovers. Preserve that burden-free boundary without inventing avoided-primary-production credits, charged remelting or separate empty-stock demand; do not replace any nonempty recovery supplier. The complete native treatment retains its own residue disposal, operations, internal energy and infrastructure once. Historical geography, background supplier mixes, slag/emission accounting, allocation, internal uncertainty, native upstream biosphere exclusions and vintage differences remain explicit warnings with unquantified score effects; full inventory or LCIA equivalence is not established. Preserve source market collection separately from native treatment-internal residue transport. Complete generic RER rail and heavy-road services follow the existing exact whole-freight witnesses, not coal-only CN rail or diesel-only US rail; retain all individual entries and their original signed tkm, without aggregation, normalization, traction/distance/payload factors or duplicate vehicle infrastructure. Restore the original freight uncertainty missing from the earlier aluminium composition. The existing aluminium default target and every non3.9profile entry and recipe remain unchanged. No SwissFAE correspondence, fly-ash extraction, new recovery technology, moisture/density factor, standalone scrap recovery/freight approval, reverse or cross-model route is admitted. Preserve caller signed quantities, uncertainty, formulas, ownership, separate emissions and purchases. Only the two inspected3.9cutoff profiles receive new Premise approvals; old aluminium raw-profile availability does not admit unapproved CLIC scopes.
